title: Haymaking

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: The sun's shining and the grass is cut: it's haymaking time! We must get it in before it rains.

intro.speaker: hannah
intro.text: Will you gather the hay into bundles? Four armfuls in each bundle.

steps.speaker: hannah
steps.prompt: Put four armfuls of hay in each bundle. Count as you go.
steps.hint: Find a bundle with an empty dip, and put some hay there.

older.prompt: Four armfuls in each of five bundles. No dips to help: count in fours.

feedback.full: That bundle is full. Try the next one.
feedback.all_good: Sixteen armfuls in four bundles! The barn will smell of summer all winter.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Make hay while the sun shines, my grandmother used to say. And we did!

journal_line: I helped bring in the hay at Mrs. Hannah's farm.

outro.speaker: hannah
outro.text: Five bundles of four: twenty armfuls! Make hay while the sun shines.
